plot: Paul Atreides unites with Chani and the Fremen while seeking revenge against the conspirators who destroyed his family.
title: Dune: Part Two
fullplot: Following the events of the first film, Paul Atreides joins the Fremen and becomes Muad'Dib while embracing his destiny on the desert planet Arrakis. As he learns to harness the power of the spice and the sandworms, he must choose between love and the fate of the universe, confronting the forces that conspired against House Atreides.

awards.text: Won 6 Oscars including Best Visual Effects. 8 nominations total.

plot: Deadpool is recruited by the Time Variance Authority to join a team tasked with saving his universe, teaming up with a reluctant Wolverine.
title: Deadpool & Wolverine
fullplot: Wade Wilson's peaceful existence comes crashing down when the Time Variance Authority recruits him for a mission that will change the history of the Marvel Cinematic Universe. Reluctantly teaming up with a Wolverine from another timeline, Deadpool must save his world from oblivion.

awards.text: 2 wins including Best Stunt Ensemble. 3 nominations.

plot: Riley's mind headquarters undergoes a sudden demolition to make room for new emotions, as she enters her teenage years.
title: Inside Out 2
fullplot: Teenager Riley's mind headquarters is undergoing a sudden demolition to make room for something entirely unexpected: new Emotions. Joy, Sadness, Anger, Fear and Disgust have long been running a successful operation, but when Anxiety shows up, they aren't sure how to feel.

awards.text: 1 win. 2 nominations including Best Animated Feature.

plot: Elphaba, a misunderstood young woman with green skin, and Glinda, a popular girl, become friends at Shiz University in the Land of Oz.
title: Wicked
fullplot: Elphaba, a young woman ridiculed for her green skin, and Glinda, a popular girl, become friends at Shiz University in the Land of Oz. After an encounter with the Wonderful Wizard of Oz, their friendship reaches a crossroads and their lives take very different paths.

awards.text: 3 wins including Best Production Design. 10 Oscar nominations.

plot: Years after the death of Emperor Marcus Aurelius, Lucius is forced to enter the Colosseum after his home is conquered by tyrannical emperors.
title: Gladiator II
fullplot: Years after witnessing the death of the revered hero Maximus at the hands of his uncle, Lucius is forced to enter the Colosseum after his home is conquered by the tyrannical Emperors who now lead Rome with an iron fist. With rage in his heart and the future of the Empire at stake, Lucius must look to his past to find strength and honor to return the glory of Rome to its people.

plot: While scavenging the deep ends of a derelict space station, a group of young space colonizers come face to face with the most terrifying life form in the universe.
title: Alien: Romulus
fullplot: While scavenging the deep ends of a derelict space station, a group of young space colonizers come face to face with the most terrifying life form in the universe. Set between the events of Alien and Aliens, the film follows Rain and her companions as they fight to survive against the Xenomorph threat.

plot: A young Bob Dylan arrives in New York City in 1961 and transforms folk music forever.
title: A Complete Unknown
fullplot: In 1961, a 19-year-old Bob Dylan arrives in New York City with his guitar and forges relationships with musical icons on his meteoric rise, culminating in a groundbreaking performance that reverberates around the world.

awards.text: Timothée Chalamet won Best Actor at the Golden Globes. 8 Oscar nominations.

plot: Twin brothers return to their hometown hoping for a fresh start, only to discover an even greater evil waiting for them.
title: Sinners
fullplot: Trying to leave their troubled lives behind, twin brothers return to their hometown to start again, only to discover that an even greater evil is waiting to welcome them back. Set in 1932 Mississippi, the film blends Southern Gothic horror with a story of redemption and survival.

plot: Superman must reconcile his alien Kryptonian heritage with his human upbringing as reporter Clark Kent.
title: Superman
fullplot: Superman must reconcile his alien Kryptonian heritage with his human upbringing as reporter Clark Kent. As the embodiment of truth, justice and the American way, he soon finds himself in a world that views these ideals as old-fashioned.

plot: Ethan Hunt and his team race against time to track down a terrifying new weapon that threatens all of humanity.
title: Mission: Impossible - The Final Reckoning
fullplot: Ethan Hunt and his IMF team embark on their most dangerous mission yet: to track down a terrifying new weapon that threatens all of humanity before it falls into the wrong hands. With control of the future and the fate of the world at stake, a deadly race around the globe begins.

plot: After the Rebels are brutally overpowered by the Empire, Luke Skywalker begins Jedi training with Yoda.
title: The Empire Strikes Back
fullplot: The Imperial Forces, under orders from Darth Vader, hold Princess Leia hostage in their efforts to quell the rebellion against the Galactic Empire. Luke Skywalker and Han Solo must rescue her while Luke trains as a Jedi Knight under the tutelage of the wise Yoda.

plot: Archaeologist Indiana Jones races Nazis to find the Ark of the Covenant.
title: Raiders of the Lost Ark
fullplot: In 1936, archaeologist and adventurer Indiana Jones is hired by the U.S. government to find the Ark of the Covenant before the Nazis can obtain its awesome powers.

plot: A troubled child summons the courage to help a friendly alien escape Earth.
title: E.T. the Extra-Terrestrial
fullplot: A meek and alienated little boy finds a stranded extraterrestrial. He has to find the courage to defy the authorities to help the alien return to its home planet.

plot: A blade runner must pursue and terminate replicants who have returned to Earth.
title: Blade Runner
fullplot: A blade runner must pursue and terminate four replicants who stole a ship in space and have returned to Earth to find their creator.

plot: A family heads to an isolated hotel where a sinister presence influences the father into violence.
title: The Shining
fullplot: A family heads to an isolated hotel for the winter where a sinister presence influences the father into violence, while his psychic son sees horrific forebodings from both past and future.

plot: A teenager is accidentally sent thirty years into the past in a time-traveling DeLorean.
title: Back to the Future
fullplot: Marty McFly, a 17-year-old high school student, is accidentally sent thirty years into the past in a time-traveling DeLorean invented by his close friend, the maverick scientist Doc Brown.

plot: Decades after surviving the Nostromo incident, Ellen Ripley is sent back to LV-426.
title: Aliens
fullplot: Decades after surviving the Nostromo incident, Ellen Ripley is sent out to re-establish contact with a terraforming colony but finds herself battling the planet's deadly alien lifeforms once again.

plot: A bedridden boy's grandfather reads him the story of a farmboy-turned-pirate.
title: The Princess Bride
fullplot: While home sick in bed, a young boy's grandfather reads him the story of a farmboy-turned-pirate who encounters numerous obstacles, enemies and allies in his quest to be reunited with his true love.

plot: A New York City cop tries to save his estranged wife and others taken hostage by terrorists.
title: Die Hard
fullplot: An NYPD officer tries to save his wife and several others taken hostage by German terrorists during a Christmas party at the Nakatomi Plaza in Los Angeles.

plot: A self-centered hotshot learns he has an autistic brother and they embark on a cross-country trip.
title: Rain Man
fullplot: After a selfish L.A. yuppie learns his estranged father left his fortune to an autistic savant brother he never knew he had, he absconds with his brother in an attempt to gain a larger inheritance.

awards.text: Won 4 Oscars including Best Picture. 8 nominations.

plot: The story of Henry Hill and his life in the mob.
title: Goodfellas
fullplot: The story of Henry Hill and his life in the mob, covering his relationship with his wife Karen Hill and his mob partners Jimmy Conway and Tommy DeVito.

plot: A young FBI cadet must receive the help of an incarcerated cannibal killer to catch another serial killer.
title: The Silence of the Lambs
fullplot: A young F.B.I. cadet must receive the help of an incarcerated and manipulative cannibal killer to help catch another serial killer, a madman who skins his victims.

awards.text: Won 5 Oscars including Best Picture. 7 nominations.

plot: A pragmatic paleontologist tours an almost complete theme park on an island in Central America.
title: Jurassic Park
fullplot: A pragmatic paleontologist touring an almost complete theme park on an island in Central America is tasked with protecting a couple of kids after a power failure causes the park's cloned dinosaurs to run loose.

plot: The lives of two mob hitmen, a boxer, and others intertwine in four tales of violence.
title: Pulp Fiction
fullplot: The lives of two mob hitmen, a boxer, a gangster and his wife, and a pair of diner bandits intertwine in four tales of violence and redemption.

awards.text: Won 1 Oscar. 7 nominations including Best Picture.

plot: Two imprisoned men bond over a number of years, finding solace and eventual redemption.
title: The Shawshank Redemption
fullplot: Two imprisoned men bond over a number of years, finding solace and eventual redemption through acts of common decency.

plot: A cowboy doll is profoundly threatened when a new spaceman action figure supplants him.
title: Toy Story
fullplot: A cowboy doll is profoundly threatened and jealous when a new spaceman action figure supplants him as top toy in a boy's bedroom.

plot: A seventeen-year-old aristocrat falls in love with a kind but poor artist aboard the luxurious ship.
title: Titanic
fullplot: A seventeen-year-old aristocrat falls in love with a kind but poor artist aboard the luxurious, ill-fated R.M.S. Titanic.

awards.text: Won 11 Oscars including Best Picture. 14 nominations.

plot: Following the Normandy Landings, a group of U.S. soldiers go behind enemy lines to retrieve a paratrooper.
title: Saving Private Ryan
fullplot: Following the Normandy Landings, a group of U.S. soldiers go behind enemy lines to retrieve a paratrooper whose brothers have been killed in action.

plot: A computer hacker learns about the true nature of his reality and his role in the war against its controllers.
title: The Matrix
fullplot: When a beautiful stranger leads computer hacker Neo to a forbidding underworld, he discovers the shocking truth: the life he knows is the elaborate deception of an evil cyber-intelligence.

plot: An insomniac office worker and a devil-may-care soap maker form an underground fight club.
title: Fight Club
fullplot: An insomniac office worker and a devil-may-care soap maker form an underground fight club that evolves into much more.

plot: A former Roman General sets out to exact vengeance against the corrupt emperor who murdered his family.
title: Gladiator
fullplot: A former Roman General sets out to exact vengeance against the corrupt emperor who murdered his family and sent him into slavery.

awards.text: Won 5 Oscars including Best Picture. 12 nominations.

plot: A meek Hobbit and eight companions set out on a journey to destroy the powerful One Ring.
title: The Lord of the Rings: The Fellowship of the Ring
fullplot: A meek Hobbit from the Shire and eight companions set out on a journey to destroy the powerful One Ring and save Middle-earth from the Dark Lord Sauron.

plot: During her family's move to the suburbs, a sullen 10-year-old girl wanders into a world ruled by gods and spirits.
title: Spirited Away
fullplot: During her family's move to the suburbs, a sullen 10-year-old girl wanders into a world ruled by gods, witches, and spirits, and where humans are changed into beasts.

awards.text: Won 1 Oscar for Best Animated Feature.

plot: When their relationship turns sour, a couple undergoes a medical procedure to have each other erased from their memories.
title: Eternal Sunshine of the Spotless Mind
fullplot: When their relationship turns sour, a couple undergoes a medical procedure to have each other erased from their memories.

plot: An undercover cop and a mole in the police attempt to identify each other while infiltrating an Irish gang.
title: The Departed
fullplot: An undercover cop and a mole in the police attempt to identify each other while infiltrating an Irish gang in South Boston.

awards.text: Won 4 Oscars including Best Picture. 10 nominations.

plot: In the Falangist Spain of 1944, a bookish young stepdaughter of a sadistic army officer escapes into a dark fantasy world.
title: Pan's Labyrinth
fullplot: In the Falangist Spain of 1944, the bookish young stepdaughter of a sadistic army officer escapes into an eerie but captivating fantasy world.

plot: A story of family, religion, hatred, oil and madness, focusing on a turn-of-the-century prospector.
title: There Will Be Blood
fullplot: A story of family, religion, hatred, oil and madness, focusing on a turn-of-the-century prospector in the early days of the business.

plot: Violence and mayhem ensue after a hunter stumbles upon a drug deal gone wrong.
title: No Country for Old Men
fullplot: Violence and mayhem ensue after a hunter stumbles upon a drug deal gone wrong and more than two million dollars in cash near the Rio Grande.

awards.text: Won 4 Oscars including Best Picture. 8 nominations.

plot: In the distant future, a small waste-collecting robot inadvertently embarks on a space journey.
title: WALL-E
fullplot: In the distant future, a small waste-collecting robot inadvertently embarks on a space journey that will ultimately decide the fate of mankind.

plot: When the menace known as the Joker wreaks havoc on Gotham, Batman must accept one of the greatest tests.
title: The Dark Knight
fullplot: When the menace known as the Joker wreaks havoc and chaos on the people of Gotham, Batman must accept one of the greatest psychological and physical tests of his ability to fight injustice.

plot: A thief who steals corporate secrets through dream-sharing technology is given a chance at redemption.
title: Inception
fullplot: A thief who steals corporate secrets through the use of dream-sharing technology is given the inverse task of planting an idea into the mind of a C.E.O.

plot: As Harvard student Mark Zuckerberg creates the social networking site that would become Facebook.
title: The Social Network
fullplot: As Harvard student Mark Zuckerberg creates the social networking site that would become known as Facebook, he is sued by the twins who claimed he stole their idea.

plot: A team of explorers travel through a wormhole in space in an attempt to ensure humanity's survival.
title: Interstellar
fullplot: A team of explorers travel through a wormhole in space in an attempt to ensure humanity's survival as Earth becomes increasingly uninhabitable.

plot: A promising young drummer enrolls at a cut-throat music conservatory.
title: Whiplash
fullplot: A promising young drummer enrolls at a cut-throat music conservatory where his dreams of greatness are mentored by an instructor who will stop at nothing to realize a student's potential.

plot: In a post-apocalyptic wasteland, a woman rebels against a tyrannical ruler.
title: Mad Max: Fury Road
fullplot: In a post-apocalyptic wasteland, a woman rebels against a tyrannical ruler in search for her homeland with the aid of a group of female prisoners and a drifter named Max.

plot: While navigating their careers in Los Angeles, a pianist and an actress fall in love.
title: La La Land
fullplot: While navigating their careers in Los Angeles, a pianist and an actress fall in love while attempting to reconcile their aspirations for the future.

plot: A young African-American visits his white girlfriend's parents for the weekend.
title: Get Out
fullplot: A young African-American visits his white girlfriend's parents for the weekend, where his simmering uneasiness about their reception of him eventually reaches a boiling point.

awards.text: Won 1 Oscar. 4 nominations including Best Picture.

plot: Allied soldiers from Belgium, the British Empire and France are surrounded by the German army.
title: Dunkirk
fullplot: Allied soldiers from Belgium, the British Empire and France are surrounded by the German army and evacuated during a fierce battle in World War II.

plot: T'Challa, heir to the hidden but advanced kingdom of Wakanda, must step forward to lead his people.
title: Black Panther
fullplot: T'Challa, heir to the hidden but advanced kingdom of Wakanda, must step forward to lead his people into a new future and must confront a challenger from his country's past.

awards.text: Won 3 Oscars. 7 nominations including Best Picture.

plot: Greed and class discrimination threaten the newly formed symbiotic relationship between the wealthy Park family and the destitute Kim clan.
title: Parasite
fullplot: Greed and class discrimination threaten the newly formed symbiotic relationship between the wealthy Park family and the destitute Kim clan.

awards.text: Won 4 Oscars including Best Picture. 6 nominations.
